Manuale del Giocatore p.91-92, feat prerequisite chain: 'Int 13, Maestria in Combattimento' precedes Disarmare Migliorato / Fintare Migliorato / Sbilanciare Migliorato, matching Combat Expertise's real prerequisite role for Improved Disarm/Feint/Trip. IMPORTANT: not 'Combattimento in Finta', which was this translator's own first, wrong guess -- caught and fixed only by checking the prerequisite chain, since 'Finta' (Feint) is a completely different feat.
